title: Onye Mmeri n'etiti eluigwe abụọ
intro: N'akwụkwọ nduzi Chineke, otu onye pụtara ìhè dị ka onye ọchịchị dị ike na onye ji obi umeala na-ejere Allah ozi. Onye a gara ebe kachasị anya n'ụwa, na-ahụ ka anyanwụ na-awa n'elu ndị mmadụ pụrụ iche ma daa n'ime mmiri ojii gbara ọchịchịrị. Nke kachasị mkpa bụ na e nyere ohu a ọrụ iwu ihe mgbochi pụrụ iche megide mba nke nwere nnukwu ihe ọjọọ. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta onye a ma ama site na Quran?
clues: Onye Kasị Ebere nyere m ike na mmetụta n'ụwa
Aga m ebe anyanwụ na-awa na ebe ọ na-ada
Eruru m ndị na-anaghị aghọta okwu ọ bụla nke ọma.
E nyere m iwu ka m jiri ígwè wuo nnukwu ihe mgbochi
Ejiri m ígwè gbazere agbaze mechie oghere dị n'etiti ugwu abụọ dị elu.
Abụghị m mmụọ ozi ma ọ bụ onye amụma, kama abụghị m ohu nke Allah nyere amara.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Dhu al-Qarnayn (Onye nwere mpi abụọ)
Eze Suleiman (Solomon)
Onye Amụma Dhul-Kifl
Dhu al-Nun (Onye Mmekọ Azụ)
Mmụọ Ozi nke Ihe Mgbochi

trial.label: Ọrụ Ukwu ahụ
options: Iwu ụlọ elu ruo eluigwe
Ịrụ nnukwu ihe mgbochi ígwè megide Yajuj na Majuj
Ịmepụta ocheeze ọlaedo maka ikpe
Ịgba olulu mmiri miri emi maka ndị ezi omume
Ịrụ ụgbọ mmiri n'oge oké idei mmiri
trial.answer: Ịrụ nnukwu ihe mgbochi ígwè megide Yajuj na Majuj

location.label: Ntọala ahụ
options: Ala Uzaịr dị n'etiti osimiri abụọ
Ebe anyanwụ na-awa na isi iyi ojii apịtị
Ndagwurugwu dị nsọ nke Makkah
Ọzara nke Madyan
Agwaetiti Saịprọs
location.answer: Ebe anyanwụ na-awa na isi iyi ojii apịtị

outcome.label: Nkwa Chineke
options: E nyere paradaịs ebighị ebi ozugbo
Ifufe dị ọkụ bibiri mba ahụ
Ihe mgbochi ahụ ga-adịru ruo ụbọchị ikpe
Nnwere onwe pụọ n'ọnwụ nye ndị niile kwere ekwe
Alaeze ebighị ebi nke na-enweghị njedebe
outcome.answer: Ihe mgbochi ahụ ga-adịru ruo ụbọchị ikpe

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
